market_context: US equity futures point to a weaker open, with S&P 500 futures down roughly 0.2%-0.3% and Nasdaq futures down about 0.7% as AI and semiconductor shares retreat.[1][2] Premarket trading shows weakness in AAPL, NVDA, and GOOGL, while AMZN and TSLA are modestly higher; elevated Treasury yields and a 15.5% five-day VIX increase favor cautious, dispersion-driven trading.[9]

predictions.reasoning: Nasdaq futures are down approximately 0.7%, with AI infrastructure and semiconductor shares leading the premarket retreat.[1][2] QQQ is therefore likely to underperform broader indexes and finish about 0.7% below its previous close.

S&P 500 futures are lower by roughly 0.2%-0.3% before the open, indicating modest broad-market pressure.[1][2] Strength in selected industrial and energy earnings may limit the decline relative to technology-heavy indexes.

Apple was approximately 1.0% lower in premarket trading, materially weaker than the broad futures decline.[9] Unless early weakness reverses, the stock is likely to remain under pressure and finish near 1% below the prior close.

NVIDIA was down about 0.47% premarket while semiconductor and AI shares were identified as the main source of Nasdaq futures weakness.[2][9] The sector-specific pressure supports a modest negative close, although the decline may be limited after recent AI-stock selling.

Tesla was approximately 0.69% higher premarket despite weaker Nasdaq futures.[9] Relative strength could persist if investors rotate within large-cap technology, but the elevated volatility backdrop makes the bullish call low confidence.
